text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: page fired (PD#PD12345) — private-vpc agent heartbeat missing for customer AcmeCorp. Severity: P1. Trigger: control-plane lost heartbeats from onprem-agent (agent-id: acme-01). Link: https://pagerduty.example/PD12345

alex_oncall: Acked. I'm on it. Paging SRE.

jamie_sre: +1. I'm pulling control-plane logs and agent telemetry now. initial symptoms: repeated 'heartbeat timeout' for agent acme-01, ~3min gap then re-register attempt and immediate drop.

maya_support: Noted. Maya standing by for customer comms. CSM Liz notified.

liz_csm: Thanks, keeping Acme support looped. They reported API errors intermittently ~10:12am local. Asking for ETA, they'll hold on their side.

jamie_sre: Triage notes:
- Control plane shows influx of 503s to the private proxy for that tenant.
- Agent heartbeats missing starting 2026-03-14T10:11:20Z.
- No obvious autoscaling events.

jamie_sre: Running quick health check against the agent health endpoint (on-customer-side exposed via tunnel):
```
curl -sS https://acme-vpc-proxy.internal/agent/acme-01/health
{"status":"unreachable","error":"tcp timeout to 10.12.45.7:443"}
```

jamie_sre: Also checked control-plane logs: several TLS handshake errors then connection resets 
```
2026-03-14T10:11:23Z WARN connection: tls handshake failed: EOF from 10.12.45.7
2026-03-14T10:11:26Z ERROR heartbeat: no response from acme-01
```

alex_oncall: Can we reach their host at network level? ping/traceroute? If it's on-prem that narrows it.

ryan_infra: I'm running a tcpdump from our edge to see if SYN reaches 10.12.45.7. If not, likely network/firewall.

ryan_infra: tcpdump output shows SYNs not getting to agent IP. We're seeing retransmits and RST from gateway 10.12.45.1.

jamie_sre: Possible cause: recent ACL change on customer side or ISP device. Maya — did Acme report any maintenance?

maya_support: Acme said they did a patch last night to their internal firewall appliance but didn't expect to touch egress rules. I'm pinging them for details.

incident-bot: Escalation timer: 5m -> infra escalation.

alex_oncall: Escalate to Ryan (infra) for network debugging. Ryan any chance it's our side?

ryan_infra: quick network test from our coloc shows that 10.12.45.7 replies intermittently before going silent. Could be packet filtering. I'm going to ask Acme to run `sudo iptables -L -n --line-numbers` on their agent host to confirm.

maya_support: Acme responded: "We rolled a firewall rule overnight, see deny entry for 10.0.0.0/8 - we were trying to block internal dev subnets, looks like it matched our proxy egress by mistake"

jamie_sre: That would explain it. If agent egress to control-plane IPs blocked, heartbeat will fail. What's their proxy IP range?

liz_csm: Acme shared the firewall snippet: `-A OUTPUT -d 13.37.0.0/16 -j DROP` (they thought it was dev range).

ryan_infra: Control-plane egress IP for that tenant is 13.37.42.10 — that matches the blocked range.

alex_oncall: OK mitigation path: request Acme to add allow rule for control-plane IPs or remove the overly broad DROP. If they need a quicker workaround we can temporarily open a tunnel via our jumpbox.

maya_support: Acme Ops is applying a rule change now. ETA 5–10m. I'll update when done.

jamie_sre: If they can't change rules quickly, plan B: create bypass tunnel to agent via customer-approved bastion. Steps in runbook: /runbooks/private-vpc/agent-connect.md

alex_oncall: Noting on-call handoff coming up in ~7m. Sam (runtime) will take next 30min block. Sam — please be ready to continue if still ongoing.

sam_runtime: On call and standing by.

[~7 minutes later]

maya_support: Acme confirmed they removed the DROP for 13.37.0.0/16 and added explicit ALLOW for 13.37.42.0/24. Re-applying rules now.

jamie_sre: Re-checking health endpoint:
```
curl -sS https://acme-vpc-proxy.internal/agent/acme-01/health
{"status":"ok","uptime":"72h","version":"1.4.2"}
```

jamie_sre: Control-plane shows agent re-registered at 2026-03-14T10:19:03Z and heartbeats normalizing. Latency for proxy calls returned to baseline.

alex_oncall: Confirmed with Acme that their application stopped seeing 503s. Maya — please relay it['s fixed and ask them to monitor for 30m.

maya_support: Told Acme ops: "We've confirmed agent reconnected; please watch and reopen if anything else appears." They acknowledged.

alex_oncall: Incident status -> mitigated. Keeping thread open for postmortem and RCA.

jamie_sre: Immediate follow-ups:
- Create incident ticket and tag "private-vpc" and "customer-impact".
- Schedule RCA with Acme ops to review firewall change process.
- Add control-plane IP ranges to onboarding checklist to avoid accidental DROPs.

sam_runtime: I'll draft the post-incident notes and link to runbook updates. Assigning to jamie for RCA lead.

alex_oncall: Handoff to Sam for next oncall window. Sam you're active now.

sam_runtime: Acknowledged handoff. I'll take over monitoring and make the postmortem doc.

jamie_sre: One more datapoint: agent metrics show no token leakage or customer data exposure. No impact beyond availability.

alex_oncall: Closing page PD#PD12345 as resolved. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Page resolved (PD#PD12345) by alex_oncall at 2026-03-14T10:22:40Z.

[Post-incident action items created in our tracker: ISSUE-4821]
